_doc: One line per shot. sparse: the first line plays over the finished colour scene, the second over the pencil sketch. objects pairs each region (scenes.json order) with its spoken line and its plain on-screen caption. Sources: examples/raw/v1.1/final.md (T1-T5) and the README blind-test table. Tested by teachback.py.

car.headline: Ask AI like an expert.
car.request: Sell my car and buy a Golf.
sparse: Ask AI like an expert, and you get the full picture.
Most of us just type ‘sell my car and buy a Golf’, and get a sketch.
sketch: Meet deeper, a free add-on for AI assistants. Before the AI starts, deeper rewrites your prompt the way an expert would write it.
It adds what a car dealer would think of: where to start, which tools to use, and how to check it worked.
objects: Price it from real listings of the same car.
Price it from similar cars for sale
Get two firm offers before you sell.
Two firm offers set your lowest price
Have any used car checked before you buy it.
Get a used car inspected before you buy
And make sure a Golf suits the way you drive.
Check a Golf suits how you drive
colour: You see the new prompt first, and nothing runs until you say yes.
car.payoff: Same prompt. A car dealer's answer.

blind.headline: We tested it blind.
sparse: Does this actually make AI better? We tested it blind.
Meet deeper, a free add-on for AI assistants. Before the AI starts, deeper rewrites your prompt the way an expert would write it.
sketch: We took five real requests and ran each one twice, once plainly and once with deeper. A separate AI marked every answer out of five, without knowing which was which.
objects: For starting from your own files and facts, the score went from one point eight to five.
Starts from your own facts: 1.8 to 5.0
For working the way an expert would, the score went from two point six to five.
Works like an expert: 2.6 to 5.0
For checking the result properly, it went from one to four point eight.
Checks the result: 1.0 to 4.8
And for sticking to what you asked for, it went from two point two to four.
Sticks to what you asked: 2.2 to 4.0
colour: Five requests is a small test, and every one of them is public.
